description: This file defines the LocalSiloHealthMonitor class, which monitors the health of a local node in an Orleans cluster using various heuristics, including checking silo status, received pings, thread pool delays, and health check participants. It provides methods to compute a health degradation score and maintains complaints about current issues.

classes.name: LocalSiloHealthMonitor
classes.description: A class that monitors the health of an Orleans silo node using heuristics such as silo status, ping responses, thread pool delays, and health check participants.

classes.name: ThreadPoolMonitor
classes.description: A nested class that measures the delay in the .NET ThreadPool queue to detect potential thread starvation or long GC pauses.

methods.name: GetLocalHealthDegradationScore
methods.description: Calculates the health degradation score based on various heuristics, returning a value between 0 (healthy) and MaxScore (unhealthy).

methods.name: GetLocalHealthDegradationScore
methods.description: Overload that populates complaints list with current health issues and returns the score.

methods.name: CheckThreadPoolQueueDelay
methods.description: Checks the delay in the thread pool queue and adds to the score if delays are detected.

methods.name: CheckSuspectingNodes
methods.description: Checks if the silo is suspected by others or not active, contributing to the score.

methods.name: CheckReceivedProbeRequests
methods.description: Checks if recent probe requests have been received from other nodes.

methods.name: CheckReceivedProbeResponses
methods.description: Checks if recent successful probe responses have been received from other nodes.

methods.name: CheckLocalHealthCheckParticipants
methods.description: Checks the health of local health check participants.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Asynchronous loop that periodically updates the complaints and health score.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the monitor to the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops the health monitoring loop and disposes resources.
